releaseNotes:
LifeOS v4.0 (4.0.0 · Build 93):
• Fixed Warm Brown Single-Hue Theme: Removed color adaptation from Settings and locked the entire app to Warm Brown (#7B4B36 → #A46D52, sand accent #D29B7E) across every interface, icon, and widget.
• Six New Liquid Glass Interfaces: Added Focus Studio (/focus), Daily Journal & Wind-Down (/journal with 7-day week strip & task rollover), Inner Circle CRM (/circle), Projects & Milestones (/projects), Trips & Smart Packing (/trips), and Decision Workbench (/decisions).
• Luna AI Co-Pilot & Privacy Hardening: Connected Luna AI across all 6 new interfaces with privacy/PII redaction (hideFromAi journal lock, phone/PNR scrubbing), confirmed tool actions, and contextual starter chips.
• Alphabetical More Hub Organization: Grouped More Hub and bottom-dock slot customization by domain work and sorted sections & interfaces A–Z.
